introduction: Montana unemployment insurance provides temporary wage replacement for eligible workers. Claimant resources explain filing and continued payment requests.
description: Montana unemployment insurance provides temporary wage replacement for eligible workers. Claimant resources explain filing and continued payment requests.

sections.who: Work history, job separation and weekly eligibility conditions affect a claim. Follow current work-search instructions.
sections.get: The agency determines payable benefits. An estimator is only an approximation.
sections.docs:
• Identity and employer details.
  • Separation information.
  • Weekly earnings and work-search records.
sections.apply:
1. Start the claim

    Use Montana claimant resources and the official claim link.

  2. Read account notices

    Respond to identity, wage and eligibility questions.

  3. Request weekly payments

    Complete each week’s questions and report work accurately.
sections.after: Keep records and review the determination’s appeal instructions if you disagree.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Montana claimant resources; Claimant handbook. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
